messages:
Aisha Khan: Following up on policy engine telemetry — we need a low-cardinality way to indicate why a request fell back (latency/cost/region/tier) without spamming metrics. Thoughts?

Rafael Gomez: keep signal sparse. Emit only when a fallback actually occurs and use fixed reason keys (e.g., LATENCY, COST_LIMIT, REGION_MISS, SLA_TIER). No freeform text.

Noah Patel: +1. Also avoid attaching tenant IDs to every fallback metric. Use route_id + region + reason only. If ops needs tenant context, link to a trace sampled separately.

Ellen Park: runtime perf concern: we currently evaluate policies in two passes (match -> bind). If we add another lookup to resolve human-readable reason, that's extra work. Can we have compiler emit compact reason codes at compile time?

Rafael Gomez: propose policy compiler emit a small integer reason_code for each rule. Wire format: single byte for reason (0 = NONE, 1 = LATENCY, 2 = COST_LIMIT...). The server keeps a versioned mapping for UI decoding.

Aisha Khan: OK, how about the decision payload shape? Something minimal that the runtime can produce cheaply.

Noah Patel: decision payload (conceptual): "compat=true|false; reason=code|0; hint=opt-id|". Only serialize to logs/metrics when reason != 0. Keep hint optional and gated by config.

Ellen Park: sample agent config for toggling hint exposure:
```yaml
policy:
  expose_fallback_hint: false
  fallback_reason_bundle: "reasons-v2"
  emit_metrics_on_fallback: true
```
This lets ops turn on hints in staging only.

Rafael Gomez: telemetry line example (prom-style):
```
redwood_routing_fallback_total{reason="COST_LIMIT",route="r-12",region="eu-west-1"} 1
```
We aggregate counts; no tenant tag.

Aisha Khan: UX: console should decode the numeric code using the bundle referenced in the request (bundle id in the decision). That avoids freeform. But bundle must be short and stable.

Noah Patel: add bundle_id (short hash) to the decision but only when reason != 0. Runtime can skip attaching it on happy path to save bytes.

Ellen Park: tests: I ran a quick bench — adding a single-byte reason from compiler into the eval result adds <1us p50. double-check with large batch sizes but promising.

agent-ci: ci-job 8129001150: policy-telemetry-tests (n=64) passed. report: http://ci/reports/8129001150

Rafael Gomez: ops playbook snippet: when COST_LIMIT jump -> check workload mix, batching config, and any global quantization/profile pushes. Link to dashboard from metric docs.

Aisha Khan: security note: do not expose binding hint by default in logs. make it available via drilldown for authorized roles only. add audit log for when hint is requested.

Noah Patel: action items: Rafael to draft bundle versioning proposal, Ellen to land compiler change to emit reason_code, I (Aisha) will update metrics docs and console decode UX. Target: next Tues for PRs.

Ellen Park: will add integration test that asserts no extra metric emission on happy path.

Rafael Gomez: one more: reason strings should be human-friendly but short (max 12 chars) to keep label lengths small when decoded.

Aisha Khan: great. I'll capture this thread in the architecture notes and tag the RFC. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
